title.zh: 建屋发展（升级工程分区）（商店振兴计划）命令 2025
title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Revitalisation of Shops Scheme) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Revitalisation of Shops Scheme) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 8 July 2025.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for Revitalisation of Shops Scheme

text.en: 2. The part of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule is declared to be a precinct for the purposes of carrying out commercial property upgrading works in connection with the Revitalisation of Shops Scheme.

THE SCHEDULE
All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Yishun Avenue 5, Yishun Ring Road and Sembawang Road, comprised in Lot numbers 00822P and 04116V in Mukim 19 and on which Apartment Blocks 101, 101A, 101B, 101C, 103 and 106 are erected, and which is more particularly delineated in the Plan.
THE PLAN
YISHUN AVENUE 5 / YISHUN RING ROAD
